seo.title: Architecture, Interior & Construction Services | Katic Designs
seo.description: Architectural design, interior design, construction, turnkey projects, renovation, landscape and property care for homes and commercial spaces in Kerala and the UAE.

hero.lead: Katic Designs brings architecture, interior design, construction and related services together to create complete spaces across Kerala and the UAE.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.statement: One studio. One standard. One continuous line from first sketch to final handover.
whatWeDo.lead: KATIC is an integrated practice: architecture, interiors, construction and care delivered by one team, from concept to completion.
whatWeDo.body: Our architects, interior designers and site teams work as one, aligning ideas, materials, budgets and craft from the start.
